LABTIC MEMBERS OF THE SANGGUNIANG BAYAN Municipality of San Isidro Province of Leyte Dear Gentlemen/ Mesdames: This has reference to your 28 March 2011 Resolution requesting this Department's opinion on whether or not paragraph 7 of M.C. No. 2010-138 is applicable in the purchase, maintenance or repair of heavy equipment used for development projects of the LGU. Reference should be made to DILG-DBM Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2011-1 dated 13 April 2011 which amends DILG-DBM JMC No. 1, s. 2005 and MC No. 2010-138. The purchase of appropriate engineering equipment such as dump trucks, graders and pay loaders are expressly authorized under paragraph 3.2.2 of DILG-DBM JMC No. 2011-1 We hope to have enlightened you on this matter. Very truly yours, A . JE SB. D Director III LS08:rb IJSLG. Opinion. MC2010-138. San Isidro.Leyte.doc
